name: Viseur
description:
Customizable crosshair overlay that stays visible above fullscreen games and videos.

Cross, dot and circle shapes with color, opacity and outline, multiple profiles, keyboard shortcuts, a temporary profile while a shortcut or the right mouse button is held (or toggled), and a panel menu.

While the crosshair is shown, fullscreen direct scanout is disabled so the overlay can be drawn; hiding it restores direct scanout.
